e: Paraguay participates at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Paraguay–Philippines relations: The Philippines and Paraguay waive visa requirements for each others' citizens as part of President Peña's visit to Manila, the first presidential visit since the beginning of diplomatic relations in 1962.
The EU–Mercosur Partnership Agreement comes into effect.
Paraguay officially ratifies the EU–Mercosur Association Agreement.
The signing of the EU–Mercosur Association Agreement is held in Asunción.
